_comment: Game-art screensaver run by PCDash (saver.py). Starts after idle_minutes with no key/mouse/controller input (game_idle_minutes while a game is running), but never while a video or game keeps the screen awake, a fullscreen app is up, or the PC is locked. Any input ends it. Pictures: game-art\store\<game>\*.jpg (poster.jpg is used on the portrait Onn). Changes apply within a few seconds.
